note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Rocky Mountain RD), along the North Fork of the Sun River between two cliffs in Sun Canyon: from Augusta, Manix Street west ~4 mi, then FR 108 west ~17 mi. Interior road narrow. Trout fishing (rainbow, westslope cutthroat), a boat launch, and the Mortimer Gulch National Recreation Trail nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Apr 29, 2026): confirmed $10 (+$5 extra vehicle), 15 sites, vault toilets; changed potable_water true -> false ('Potable water is not available at this site'); added season not year-round (late spring - early fall). Page silent on how sites are taken, stay limit and length (derived FCFS, 14-day, 35 ft left). No alert for the campground or FR 108 (the only Rocky Mountain RD road closure is FR 8998).
